_: Exemptions for tools/check_locations.py. Nothing here is a licence to add a new absolute path; each entry says why one particular file that ALREADY has one is not going to be fixed. Artefact entries are pinned by sha256, so a regeneration that is still dirty loses the exemption and comes back red. Run entries are dated and counted, so a write-once archive that gains an absolute path after it was signed off comes back red too.
_runs_note: Every run directory below is captured tool output or a write-once provenance record: Fast Downward logs naming the .worktrees path and the gitignored .toolchain binary, session transcripts, MANIFEST files written at run time. The recording location is part of the record; scrubbing it falsifies captured output, and regeneration would need untracked toolchains and would change the measured numbers. What is exposed is an account name, not a secret. Listed one directory at a time and dated, so that a NEW run directory carrying an absolute path is a red gate rather than a silent inheritance.
